title: WordPress core bug under attack: update your site tonight (CVE-2026-119977)
description:
Run a WordPress site? Hackers are attacking a bug in WordPress itself.

On November 3, 2026, the US agency CISA added CVE-2026-119977, a WordPress Core flaw, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, confirming active exploitation. The weakness is in the WordPress upgrade process: during a full core upgrade, an unauthenticated attacker can run code on the server through predictable, web-accessible staging paths.

Security firm Wordfence says it blocked 13,095 attacks against this flaw in 24 hours (vendor figure).

Analyst note: updating is still the fix. WordPress 7.1.4, released October 28, 2026, fixes it, and security fixes were backported to older branches (currently through 4.7).

Do this tonight:
1. In your WordPress admin, open Dashboard, then Updates, and check your version.
2. Install the latest release (7.1.4, or the latest security release for your branch).
3. Keep automatic background updates switched on.

Sources
- WordPress.org, WordPress 7.1.4 release (Oct 28, 2026): https://wordpress.org/news/2026/10/wordpress-7-1-4/
- CISA alert (Nov 3, 2026): https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/03/cisa-adds-one-known-exploited-vulnerability-catalog
- BleepingComputer (Nov 4, 2026): https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-flags-wordpress-rce-flaw-as-actively-exploited-in-attacks/
- The Hacker News (Nov 4, 2026): https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-confirms-hackers-exploiting.html

Narration uses an AI voice (ElevenLabs). Research, script and fact-check by Securidge.
